name: Tally Accounting
tagline: Tax, bookkeeping and advice for small businesses and the people who run them.
response_note: We answer every call and email within one business day — in tax season too.

steps.title: A free twenty-minute call
steps.body: Tell us what you run and what keeps you up at night. We’ll tell you plainly whether we’re the right fit.

steps.title: A fixed monthly fee
steps.body: One written quote covering everything we agreed. No hourly billing, no surprise invoices in April.

steps.title: We take over the paperwork
steps.body: We connect your bank feeds, collect last year’s returns and tidy the books — you send one folder.

steps.title: Numbers you can read
steps.body: A one-page report on the fifth of the month, and a person who picks up when you call.

bring.item: Last year’s tax return, federal and state
W-2s, 1099s and any K-1s you’ve received
Business bank and card statements for the year
Mortgage interest, childcare and donation receipts
Any letters you’ve had from the IRS or the state

art_direction.identity: A modern small accounting practice that feels like well-kept working papers: warm paper canvas, near-black ink, hairline rules, tabular figures, bright daylight photography of real desks and real clients, and one ballpoint-blue accent.
art_direction.type: IBM Plex Sans for headings (medium weight, tight tracking) and body at 1rem with relaxed leading; IBM Plex Mono ONLY for figures — dates, fees, hours, phone numbers, the months on the calendar. Never set a heading or a sentence in mono.
art_direction.color: Paper canvas and surface, ink text in two tiers (ink, muted), line for hairline rules. One accent: primary (ballpoint blue) for the main button, the tax-year calendar band, and link hovers. Text on primary uses primary-foreground. The ink panel (secondary) closes the page. Never add a second accent.
art_direction.signature: The tax-year calendar (sections/calendar) — a full-width blue band with a twelve-month rail, every filing deadline marked at its point in the year, a 'today' line, and the next deadline highlighted. Keep it on the homepage wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Plain, calm and exact. Short sentences, real numbers, no jargon, no fear-selling about the IRS, no exclamation points.
